parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID of the instances.

><notice>This parameter is deprecated and is not recommended.></notice>

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID array. Array length: 1 to 100.

Example: ["i-bp1j4i2jdf3owlhe****", "i-bp1j4i2jdf3o1234****"].

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the instance status list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instances. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone to which the instances belong. You can call [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) to query the most recent zone list.
